title: Stability Bands for Feature Attribution: The Core, the Nucleolus and the Bargaining Set of Explained-Variance Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.25238v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Shapley-value attributions are the default way of explaining machine-learning predictions in economics, but they report a single number per feature and say nothing about whether a coalition of features that jointly accounts for more than it receives could contest that allocation. We study feature attribution through the core, the nucleolus and the bargaining set of an explained-variance game, in which the worth of a set of features is the variance of the model's predictions that those features generate. For every feature we report a stability band (its range of shares over the core, or over the least core when the core is empty), with the nucleolus as distinguished point and a certificate that the allocation admits no justified objection. Three results organise the approach. First, for linear models the game is exactly 2-additive, with pairwise Harsanyi dividends $2\beta_i\beta_j\sigma_{ij}$, so multicollinearity is what creates coalit

translated_title: 特征归因的稳定性区间：解释方差博弈的核心、核仁与谈判集
translated_abstract: 沙普利值归因是经济学中解释机器学习预测的默认方法，但它对每个特征只报告一个数字，并且无法说明一组联合贡献超过其所获份额的特征联盟是否可能对该分配提出异议。我们通过解释方差博弈的核心、核仁和谈判集来研究特征归因，其中一组特征的“价值”定义为这些特征所生成的模型预测的方差。对于每个特征，我们报告一个稳定性区间（其份额在核心中的取值范围，或在核心为空时在最小核心中的取值范围），以核仁作为显著参考点，并给出该分配不受理据充分的异议质疑的证明。三个结果支撑了这一方法：首先，对于线性模型，该博弈恰好是2-可加的，其成对哈萨尼红利为 $2\beta_i\beta_j\sigma_{ij}$，因此多重共线性正是产生联盟……
tldr: 该论文提出用解释方差博弈的核心、核仁与谈判集为每个特征刻画“稳定性区间”，以证明归因分配不会被特征联盟合理质疑，并证明线性模型下该博弈恰为2-可加，多重共线性正是联盟效应的根源。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces stability bands for feature attribution via the core, nucleolus and bargaining set of explained-variance games, certifying that allocations admit no justified coalitional objection, and proves that for linear models the game is exactly 2-additive with pairwise Harsanyi dividends, making multicollinearity the source of coalitional effects.
